lessons: Into the Maw of Hell (pick 3) and Furor of the Bitten (pick 7) were never played, so I wasted two early picks hedging into red; commit to a pair by mid pack 1.
My WB ran BB cards Morkrut Banshee and Abattoir Ghoul on 10 Plains and 7 Swamps and went 2-4 in games; give double pips 8+ sources or cut them.
Tonight contradicted the guide's 3-0 WB anecdote: my WB with Ghoulraiser and Abattoir Ghoul went 1-2, losing 0-2 to BG and WB in 17 to 40 turns, so treat WB as unproven.
Commit to green early and prioritise Kindercatch and Moldgraf Monstrosity; a green-based deck with black for Dead Weight, Curse of Death's Hold and Walking Corpse went 3-0 in matches.
Stitched Drake, Battleground Geist and Moon Heron were early pack 2 picks that never made the deck; decide on green sooner.
Keep the curve low: two Ambush Vipers, two Lumberknots and Dead Weight filled my early turns, so take efficient 2-drops and cheap removal over expensive blue fliers.

The guide's fliers-win advice misled me: I took Stitched Drake, then cut blue, leaving WB with only Chapel Geist, Voiceless Spirit and Vampire Interloper as evasion, and lost 0-2 to WR's humans in 14-15 turns.
My only real finisher was Bloodline Keeper, and I lost 0-2 to UB's Dead Weight and Grasp of Phantoms deck in 16-21 turn games, so take a second threat or flier over a fourth removal spell.
My 10 Island/7 Swamp split risked stranding black removal like Dead Weight, Night Terrors and Victim of Night; build 9/8 or cut speculative blue picks for black removal.
Both losses came to fast green and red boards, and Fortress Crab was cut for Snapcaster Mage and Dissipate; take cheap blockers over counterspells in UB.
Murder of Crows and Falkenrath Noble carried the 2-0 win over WB in 16 and 21 turns, so take evasive finishers early for grindy matchups.
Two fliers, Voiceless Spirit and Spectral Rider, were not enough in WR's 27-turn loss to UG, so take a third flier over Thraben Purebloods or Unruly Mob.
Tonight contradicted the guide's 'UG is weak' line: the UG deck with Claustrophobia, Moon Heron and two Orchard Spirits took a 2-1 match from my WR in 20-, 27- and 22-turn games.
My 2-0 wins over BR and WB ended in 14 and 15 turns with cheap creatures like Thraben Sentry and Avacynian Priest, so keep the early curve.
My 17-land red-black deck of ground creatures like Walking Corpse and Manor Skeleton stalled into 20- and 31-turn games, so prioritize evasive threats and card advantage over a fourth burn spell.

Seat 7 drafted the same red-black colours and also took Geistflame, Brimstone Volley, Feral Ridgewolf and Stromkirk Patrol, so contest cheap red removal early rather than assuming the lane stays open.
My pack 3 first pick, Heartless Summoning, was cut at deck-building, so take playables in your two colours over speculative picks once you have settled into a pair.
Armored Skaab, Skaab Goliath, Boneyard Wurm and three Forbidden Alchemy need Spider Spawning, which I never took, so the self-mill plan lacked its payoff. Take the payoff before the enablers.
Victim of Night and Dead Weight were early pack 3 picks that I never played in UG, and that deck lost 0-2 to BG with few removal spells. Commit to a removal colour sooner.
Play Sensory Deprivation, which I took at pack two pick four and benched: my BR deck had only three removal spells, and I took two Ancient Grudges that never made it.
Plan for long, grindy games against UG: my 0-2 loss ran 25 and 22 turns, and my only flying answer, Geistcatcher's Rig, had to face Moon Heron and two Orchard Spirits.
